internal_measurement.results: Release-mode USI binary was rebuilt from commit 4d3e731. Workspace tests, lint, formatting, the stdlib A/B-runner early-stop test, documentation-reference, public-surface, release-manifest, and cargo-publish-workflow checks passed. The USI smoke transcript reached usiok and readyok. For the refactor commits, fixed 100k-node probes on 50 positions and depth-12 node counts on 20 positions preserved best move, score, depth, and node count; the recorded checks matched on x86 and Arm. The refactor has no claimed speed or playing-strength result.

external_opponents.configuration: No external-engine comparison was run for this behavior-preserving refactor release.

known_limitations: The recorded fixed-node probes cover the stated positions and budgets only; they do not prove equivalence for every position, time control, or parallel-search configuration.
No speed, Elo, or external-engine superiority claim is made for this refactor release.
No NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
External HalfKP 256x2-32-32 inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
